name: Path of the Tempest

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

text:
Frequency once per 10 minutes;

---
Effect Your familiar summons winds that speed up and protect you. You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed until the end of your turn. When you Stride this turn, you don't trigger reactions. In addition, you don't need to Stride before a Long Jump this turn.

Effect: Path of the Tempest
